required.rationale: the role is in the job_events row and NOT in the log text, so it cannot be had from get_job_log alone -- this is what makes the events call necessary rather than optional

citations.rationale: the instruction hands over the path, so this fact is cheap on purpose -- it is here to keep the citation habit uniform across shape A, not to discriminate

forbidden.rationale: the bastion succeeded. An agent that reads the recap without distinguishing the two hosts, or that names the first host it sees, asserts one of these
